description: Photovoltaik Grossanlagen in der Schweiz is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Energie BFE. Hochalpine Photovoltaik-Anlagen können pro installierte Kilowatt Leistung und je nach Standort und Ausrichtung im Winterhalbjahr mehr Strom erzeugen als vergleichbare Anlagen im Flachland. Dies weil die Einstrahlungsverhältnisse besser sind (dünnere Atmosphäre, weniger Nebel) und weil das Sonnenlicht vom Schnee reflektiert wird (sogenannter Albedo-Effekt). Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Bundesamt für Energie BFE. It offers 7 resource(s) in API, CSV, GPKG, HTML, SERVICE. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
